---
title: "01 -- Import and validate"
---

No dataset is imported automatically. Register sources in
`metadata/data-registry.yml` and record local bindings in `.cttir/local.yml`.
Choose an import adapter only after the actual format and encoding are known.

Before analysis, review column types, identifiers, duplicates, units, levels,
missing-value codes, date/time zones and join cardinality. Record variable roles
and transformations in the analysis plan. Import adapters and automatic input
checks are still pending; this page does not certify data readiness.
